input.file_text: # Metropolitan Museum Inventory Data Standardization ## Project Overview This archive contains the input data, transformation script, output data, and documentation for standardizing the Met Museum inventory TSV file. ## Files Included ### 1. Input Data - **met_inventory.tsv** - Original Metropolitan Museum inventory data - 300 records, 4 columns - Columns: Object Date | Title | Object Number | Link Resource - MD5 Checksum: `6ec5bfc2d979ad12eb3343149beb8617` ### 2. Transformation Script - **standardize_met_inventory.py** - Procedural Python 3 script for data standardization - Fully documented with docstrings - Includes fixity checking via MD5 checksums - Executable with command-line arguments - Can be version controlled and re-run on the same input to verify reproducibility ### 3. Output Data - **met_inventory_standardized.tsv** - Standardized version of the input data - Same row count (300 records) and column count (4) as input - All transformations applied consistently - MD5 Checksum: `ea7849011acfd1def02051dbefcb64db` ### 4. Documentation - **MANIFEST.md** (this file) - Project overview and file descriptions - **CHECKSUMS.txt** - Checksum verification file for archival fixity ## Transformations Applied ### 1. Missing Value Handling - **Object Date**: Empty values → `Unknown` (11 records affected) - **Title**: Empty values → `Untitled` (25 records affected) ### 2. Text Encoding - Decoded HTML entities (e.g., `<` → `<`, `>` → `>`) - Removed HTML tags (e.g., ``, ``) ### 3. Date Standardization | Original | Standardized | |----------|--------------| | B.C. | BCE | | BC | BCE | | A.C. | CE | | A.H. | AH | | circa | ca. | | Circa | ca. | ### 4. Character Normalization - En-dashes (–) → standard hyphens (-) - Em-dashes (—) → standard hyphens (-) - Multiple spaces → single spaces - Leading/trailing whitespace → removed ### 5. Column Name Standardization | Original | Standardized | |----------|--------------| | Object Date | Object_Date | | Title | Title | | Object Number | Object_Number | | Link Resource | Link_Resource | (Changed to snake_case format for database/programming compatibility) ## Fixity Verification To verify the integrity of the archived files, use the provided checksums: ```bash # Verify input file integrity md5sum -c <
